name: Tirish
what: Poultry feed dealers use it as their credit book, tracking what each farmer owes per batch of birds until the batch is sold.
hard_part: A database per dealer with the connection taken from the request context, so no repository query names a dealer and another shop's records return 404, not 403. The feed curve exists in Go and in the offline phone client, and a test reads the JavaScript constants to fail the build if they drift.
facts: All money stored as poisha integers, including on the wire
Zero external requests: fonts bundled, no npm dependencies
End-to-end API suite of 14 suites and 29 subtests plus 12 phone-client tests
Android app is a WebView shell around the same web app, with an offline outbox
